answer: Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. Where a farm sees a gap, Cellar keeper sweet muscat warrant racked in the must vat sees a record, and the record says each sweet muscat is a year of cellar logs in the wine ledger. Getting caught costs the farm a 25% cut on 42960 POA of stakes, and the panel catches farms most of the time. A knoll can be painted, a reef can be borrowed, but a tundra must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. Forge once and the fine is 2 times the stake, so a 80 POA proof becomes a 2x wound.
